model_class: Mann (1994, JFM 273) sheared von Karman spectral tensor

permitted_claims: full Hermitian second-order structure target (auto + cross spectra, uw < 0 surface stress, anisotropy ratios) for V-04b1 fitting
surface-layer anisotropy class u2 > v2 > w2 with |uw|/sigma_u2 in the 0.1-0.45 band
forbidden_claims: site-measured turbulence levels (none exist for 1903 Kitty Hawk)
any validated-tier claim without independent spectral evidence
notes: The shear distortion (Gamma > 0) is load-bearing: it produces the u-w cross-spectrum a diagonal-only model cannot represent (Round-3 Q2: diagonal-only may initialize, never accept). Per-truncation realizable-tensor artifacts are E3.3b-ii-b scope.
